items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And he had Red Mackie on bass that night, too.

ctx.x: Well, I thought sure that Billy was going to go into ragging scales. And he had Red Mackie on bass that night, too. and Sushant on, well they had quite an aggregation there that night and there was one little thing in there that of course the boys in Chicago and the boys in New Orleans always got along fine and they did have a beat, a similar beat, but somebody, Eddie Condon it was, they said what's the difference between New Orleans jazz and Chicago jazz and Eddie said a thousand miles. Well it's a little few…
Oh we said, talking about Mike Kaplan too, I think when the beat machine was on.
